name: idle-timeout
title: Idle Timeout
author: bespoked
description: Sets how long the printer waits, with no activity, before it powers down its motors and heaters (Klipper's idle timeout). The Snapmaker U1 ships with a short 5 minute (300 second) timeout, which can cut power mid-workflow while you swap filament or level by hand. Set the timeout you want, in seconds; the plugin overrides the printer's idle_timeout value so it sticks across prints. Default is 7200 seconds (2 hours).
tagline: Choose how long the printer stays awake before it powers its motors down.

variables.name: IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Idle timeout in seconds (a positive whole number). 3600 = 1 hour, 7200 = 2 hours.

config.label: Idle timeout (seconds)
config.hint: Seconds of inactivity before the printer powers its motors and heaters down. 3600 = 1 hour, 7200 = 2 hours. Must be a positive whole number.
